publicPricing.title: Pricing
publicPricing.footnote: Prices are in CNY. Data is metered in decimal GB (1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes). Rotating and static proxies share one account and wallet; final price and stock are confirmed at checkout.

dynamic.title: Dynamic residential proxy plans
dynamic.sub: Pay by traffic with no expiry and predictable costs, built for public data collection, ad verification, and recurring market research.

exclusive.title: Dedicated static residential plans
exclusive.sub: Long-lived residential IPs reserved solely for your team, supporting renewal and same-region replacement for e-commerce and multi-account operations.

shared.title: Shared static residential plans
shared.sub: Cost-efficient fixed residential IPs selectable by use case for lightweight fixed-exit needs.

protocol.desc: Create proxy sub-accounts in the console right after purchase to copy gateway hosts and credentials.

compliance.title: Regional availability
compliance.desc: For use outside mainland China only. Not available in mainland China.
